Leadership proposition

What I bring.

I work at the point where commercial discipline, operating systems, people and technology have to move together.

01

Cross-sector operational depth. I have led across regulated medical devices, industrial distribution, global postal logistics, express services and specialist cold chain.

02

P&L and commercial credibility. My experience includes full P&L and EBITDA accountability, portfolio leadership, pricing architecture and board reporting.

03

Transformation that sticks. I connect strategy to operating cadence, benefit realisation and the behaviours needed to sustain change.

04

Sustainability embedded in operations. I treat sustainability as an operating and commercial design question, not a separate narrative.

05

People and culture as performance. I build clear accountability, succession resilience and measurable leadership routines.
